shots.title: The narrow inlet
shots.prompt:
Cinematic painterly graphic-novel animation matching the illustrated starting frame. One continuous shot, no cuts or pose resets, natural living movement from beginning through the tail. Native 1080p, preserve the established palette and upper-right lighting. Five-second ship-free low aerial flight through a narrow turquoise tidal inlet between monumental dark blue basalt cliffs. Follow the curved water channel gently forward toward the distant open sea, with visible perspective/parallax between near cliff faces and far islands. Maintain this same illustrated alien world, peach-gold tidal shelves and sunlight from upper right. No spacecraft, person, moons, cockpit, HUD, boundary field or digital grid enters the view.
